question: The cost of painting a spherical vessel of radius 7 cm is ₹18,480. What is the cost of painting per square centimetre? ( use π = 22/7)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area of sphere = 4 × π × r² = 4 × (22/7) × 7² = 616 cm².

Rate of painting = Total Cost ÷ Total Surface Area

Rate = 18480 ÷ 616 = 30

**∴ The correct answer is ₹30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 

 

 
• 
 
 r = 7 cm
 Spherical Vessel
 Total Painting Cost = ₹18,480

**Given:**

Radius of the spherical vessel (r) = 7 cm

Total cost of painting the spherical vessel = ₹18,480

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area of a sphere = 4 × π × r²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Surface Area = 4 × (22 / 7) × (7)²

⇒ Total Surface Area = 4 × 22 × 7

⇒ Total Surface Area = 616 cm²

⇒ Cost of painting per cm² = Total Cost ÷ Total Surface Area

⇒ Cost of painting per cm² = 18480 ÷ 616

⇒ Cost of painting per cm² = 30

**∴ The correct answer is ₹30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The volume of a sphere is given by V = (4/3) × π × r³.

Hemisphere

When a sphere is cut into two equal halves, each flat-surfaced half is called a hemisphere.

Surface Area of a Hemisphere

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r² | Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3 × π × r².
